title: Unsupervised learning needs to become more important
description: The authors expect unsupervised learning to become far more important in the longer term, motivated by the observation that humans and animals learn largely without explicit supervision.
canonical_description: unsupervised learning needs to be advanced to match human-like learning

evidence.anchor: we expect unsupervised learning to become far more important
evidence.quote: Although we have not focused on it in this Review, we expect unsupervised learning to become far more important in the longer term.
